entries.title: Romans 3:1
segments: Then what [is] the superiority of the Jew? Or what [is] the profit of circumcision?

entries.title: Romans 3:2
segments: Much, by every way! Chiefly, indeed, because they were entrusted with the oracles of God.

entries.title: Romans 3:3
segments: For what? If some did not believe, will not their unbelief nullify the faith of God?

entries.title: Romans 3:4
segments: Let it not be! But let God be true, and every man a liar; as it is written, "That You might be justified in Your sayings, and will overcome when You are judged."

entries.title: Romans 3:5
segments: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what shall we say? [Is] God unrighteous who lays on wrath? (I speak as a man.)

entries.title: Romans 3:6
segments: Let it not be! For then how shall God judge the world?

entries.title: Romans 3:7
segments: For if in my lie the truth has more abounded to His glory why am I still judged as a sinner?

entries.title: Romans 3:8
segments: And not [rather], (as we are wrongly accused, and as some affirm that we say), Let us do bad things that good may come? [Their] condemnation is just.

entries.title: Romans 3:9
segments: What then? Do we excel? No, in no way; for we have before charged both Jews and Greeks all [with] being under sin,

entries.title: Romans 3:10
segments: as it is written: "There is none righteous, no not one;

entries.title: Romans 3:11
segments: there is none that understands, there is none that seeks after God."

entries.title: Romans 3:12
segments: "They are all gone out of the way, [they] have together become unprofitable, there is none that does good, no, not one."

entries.title: Romans 3:13
segments: "Their throat [is] an open grave, with their tongues they have used deceit, [the] poison of asps [is] under their lips;

entries.title: Romans 3:14
segments: whose mouth [is] full of cursing and bitterness;"

entries.title: Romans 3:15
segments: "their feet [are] swift to shed blood;

entries.title: Romans 3:16
segments: destruction and misery [are] in their way,

entries.title: Romans 3:17
segments: and the way of peace they did not know."

entries.title: Romans 3:18
segments: "There is no fear of God before their eyes."

entries.title: Romans 3:19
segments: But we know that whatever things the Law says, it says to those who are under the Law; so that every mouth may be stopped and all the world may be under judgment before God,

entries.title: Romans 3:20
segments: because by the works of the Law none of all flesh will be justified in His sight; for through the Law [is] the knowledge of sin.

entries.title: Romans 3:21
segments: But now a righteousness of God has been revealed apart from Law, being witnessed by the Law and the Prophets;

entries.title: Romans 3:22
segments: even the righteousness of God through the faith of Jesus Christ, toward all and upon all those who believe. For there is no difference,

entries.title: Romans 3:23
segments: for all have sinned and come short of the glory of God,

entries.title: Romans 3:24
segments: being justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus;

entries.title: Romans 3:25
segments: whom God has set forth [to be] a propitiation through faith in His blood, to declare His righteousness through the passing by of the sins that had taken place before, in the forbearance of God;

entries.title: Romans 3:26
segments: for the display of His righteousness at this time, for Him to be just and, forgiving the [one] being of the faith of Jesus.

entries.title: Romans 3:27
segments: Then where [is] the boasting? It is excluded. Through what law? Of works? No, but through the law of faith.

entries.title: Romans 3:28
segments: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the works of the law.

entries.title: Romans 3:29
segments: Or [is He] the God of the Jews only, and not also of the nations? Yes, of the nations also,

entries.title: Romans 3:30
segments: since [it is] one God who will justify circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

entries.title: Romans 3:31
segments: Do we then make the Law void through faith? Let it not be! But we establish the Law.
